title: Catalog service and its typed TypeScript client
area: Python application backend and API contracts
scenario: The assistant and the React storefront need product search, product detail with stock per store and pickup reservations. The prototype uses offset paging, plain-text errors and hand-written TypeScript types that already disagree with the service. Own the contract end to end: FastAPI service, OpenAPI document and the generated, typed client.
task: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0: search, filters, keyset cursor pagination with a stable order and a page cap
RFC 9457 problem+json errors declared in OpenAPI
Idempotent reservations with an Idempotency-Key header and no overselling
Export OpenAPI, generate TypeScript types, and build a typed fetch client on them
acceptance: Cursor walk returns every item once, in order
Replay with the same key reserves once; different body is a 422 problem; short stock is 409
Committed contract equals app.openapi(); generated TS types are current
Client encodes params, maps problem+json to CatalogError and type-checks

practices.label: Week 2 - FastAPI routers, dependency injection, error handlers
